---
title: "5.GO_heatmap"
output: html_document
date: "2026-10-16"
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(GO.db)
library(tibble)

#1. USER SETTINGS 

go_ids <- c(
  "GO:0140014",  
  "GO:0030198", 
  "GO:0007059",  
  "GO:0140013",
  "GO:0042060",
  "GO:0006260",
  "GO:0007163",
  "GO:0000910",
  "GO:0003012",
  "GO:0003014",
  "GO:0050886",
  "GO:0032200",
  "GO:0098754",
  "GO:0007018",
  "GO:0072659",
  "GO:0071941",
  "GO:0003016",
  "GO:0022600",
  "GO:0006913",
  "GO:0006310",
  "GO:0009101",
  "GO:0006575",
  "GO:0006766",
  "GO:0007005",
  "GO:0006091",
  "GO:0006790",
  "GO:0044782",
  "GO:0006520",
  "GO:0006457",
  "GO:0140053",
  "GO:0008009"
)

counts_file        <- "data/salmon.merged.gene_counts.tsv"
differentials_file <- "results/03_volcano_plot/deseq2_results_filtered.csv"
output_dir         <- "results/06_GO_expression_heatmaps"
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# 2. LOAD DATA

counts <- read_tsv(counts_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
colnames(counts) <- trimws(colnames(counts))

if(!"gene_id" %in% colnames(counts)){
  stop("Column 'gene_id' not found in counts file.")
}

counts$gene_id <- sub("\\.\\d+$", "", counts$gene_id)

diff_genes <- read_csv(differentials_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
colnames(diff_genes) <- trimws(colnames(diff_genes))
diff_genes[[1]] <- sub("\\.\\d+$", "", diff_genes[[1]])

#  3. FILTER FOR SIGNIFICANT GENES

sig_ids <- diff_genes[[10]]
counts_sig <- dplyr::filter(counts, gene_id %in% sig_ids)

message(sprintf("Genes after filtering for significance: %d", nrow(counts_sig)))

if(nrow(counts_sig) == 0){
  stop("No significant genes matched between counts and differential file.")
}

# 4. MAP ENSEMBL -> ENTREZ & SYMBOL (ONCE) 

ensembl_ids <- counts_sig$gene_id

mapping <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = ensembl_ids,
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  columns = c("ENTREZID", "SYMBOL")
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ENTREZID), !is.na(SYMBOL)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(ENSEMBL, ENTREZID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 5. CHECK REQUIRED SAMPLE COLUMNS 

required_cols <- c("HD10-diff_1","HD10-diff_2","HD10-diff_3","HD10-mockVZV_1","HD10-mockVZV_2","HD10-mockVZV_3","HD10-und_1","HD10-und_2","HD10-und_3","HD10-VZV_1","HD10-VZV_2","HD10-VZV_3")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(counts_sig))
if(length(missing_cols) > 0){
  stop(paste("Missing columns in counts file:", paste(missing_cols, collapse=", ")))
}

# 6. LOOP OVER GO TERMS 

for(go_id in go_ids){

  message("--------------------------------------------------")
  message(paste("Processing", go_id))

  # Get GO term genes
  go_genes <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys    = go_id,
    keytype = "GOALL",
    columns = "ENTREZID"
  )$ENTREZID

  go_term_name <- tryCatch(
    Term(GOTERM[[go_id]]),
    error = function(e) go_id
  )

  message(sprintf("GO term: %s (%s)", go_id, go_term_name))

  mapping_go <- dplyr::filter(mapping, ENTREZID %in% go_genes)
  message(sprintf("Significant DEGs in this GO term: %d", nrow(mapping_go)))

  if (nrow(mapping_go) == 0) {
    message("No significant genes found, skipping.")
    next
  }

  # BUILD MATRIX 

  mat_df <- counts_sig %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(mapping_go, by = c("gene_id" = "ENSEMBL")) %>%
    dplyr::select(SYMBOL, dplyr::all_of(required_cols)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(SYMBOL, .keep_all = TRUE)

  # Skip GO terms with fewer than 10 genes
min_genes <- 2

if(nrow(mat_df) < min_genes){
  message(sprintf("Only %d gene(s) for GO term %s (%s), skipping heatmap (less than %d genes).", 
                  nrow(mat_df), go_id, go_term_name, min_genes))
  next
}


mat_df <- as.data.frame(mat_df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Force SYMBOL to a plain character vector (catches list-columns from joins)
mat_df$SYMBOL <- as.character(unlist(mat_df$SYMBOL))
message(sprintf("mat_df rows: %d | SYMBOL length: %d", nrow(mat_df), length(mat_df$SYMBOL)))
if (nrow(mat_df) != length(mat_df$SYMBOL)) {
  message("Mismatch detected - printing structure for debugging:")
stop("SYMBOL column length does not match row count - check upstream join for duplicate keys.")
}

# Safety checks
mat_df <- mat_df[!is.na(mat_df$SYMBOL), , drop = FALSE]
mat_df <- mat_df[!duplicated(mat_df$SYMBOL), , drop = FALSE]

# Move SYMBOL into rownames safely (column_to_rownames avoids manual rownames<- pitfalls)
mat_df <- tibble::column_to_rownames(mat_df, "SYMBOL")

# Convert to matrix
mat <- as.matrix(mat_df)

# SCALE (Z-score per gene) 

mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(mat)))
mat_scaled[is.na(mat_scaled)] <- 0

# DEFINE COLOR SCALE CENTERED AT 0

max_val <- max(abs(mat_scaled))

breaks <- seq(-max_val, max_val, length.out = 101)
heat_colors <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(100)
  # ANNOTATIONS 

  annotation_col <- data.frame(
    Condition = factor(c(rep("Mock",3), rep("VZV",3)), levels=c("Mock","VZV"))
  )
  rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(mat_scaled)

  annotation_colors <- list(
    Condition = c(
      Mock = "lightblue",
      VZV  = "#F4A6A6"
    )
  )

  heat_colors <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(100)

  outfile <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0("Heatmap_", gsub(":", "_", go_id), "_", gsub(" ", "_", go_term_name), ".pdf")
  )

  # CREATE HEATMAP 

    hm <- pheatmap(
    mat_scaled,
    color = heat_colors,
    breaks = breaks,
    annotation_col = annotation_col,
    annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    fontsize_row = 6,
    main = paste0(go_term_name, " (", go_id, ")")
  )

#SAVE PDF

pdf(outfile, width = 8, height = 10)
print(hm)
dev.off()

# SAVE HIGH-QUALITY PNG

pngfile <- sub("\\.pdf$", ".png", outfile)

png(pngfile,
    width = 8,
    height = 10,
    units = "in",
    res = 600)

print(hm)
dev.off()

message("Saved: ", outfile)
message("Saved: ", pngfile)
}
message("All GO heatmaps generated successfully.")

```
